event.title: Nightly Wallet introduced publicly
event.description: Nightly's first-party 2022-07-04 introduction presented Nightly Wallet as the first part of the Nightly ecosystem and described its multichain wallet functionality. The source says the extension was live in the Chrome Web Store but not yet public, so this record is an announcement/introduction event and does not infer the later public launch date.

evidence.title: Hello World! Nightly Wallet
evidence.notes: First-party Nightly introduction. It documents the wallet and explicitly says the extension was not yet public, so no launch date is inferred from this source.
